items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Jolly Roll worked them. They brought them here... So Jolly Roll played in her band then.

ctx.x: Well, are the Macs still here, by the way? Yes. You know, I should talk to them again, too, because I did interview them, but I didn't talk to them about Jolly Roll. I never thought about it at that time. Well... That was ten years ago when I talked to them.

Well, Jolly Roll worked them. They brought them here, but what she would do, because her musicians couldn't read music, most of them. Yes. So she would have them learn the show. Then she'd bring the show now.
